Greetings, my hopefully healthy Novelites with awful sleep schedules. 

How are you? I am still sick - just easily fatigued with a persistent dry cough and sniffles now.

I've just landed and will now spend the day recovering before being placed into the hamster wheel of content soon for work.

So far, Henmama (he) and Kappapa (she) have both gotten me my favorite type of onigiri and some vitamin C drinks to help me heal faster.

They gave it at separate meetings then started bickering over who got it to me first, and I told them, with a sniffly voice, "Stop fighting in front of the child!" 
(I am that child.)

I am forcing myself to drink this CARBONATED Kuromi-branded vitamin drink. 
I'm still playing detective on who bought it to pin the blame on them. 
(May their guilt scream until they come forward with their crime.)

A big thanks to Kappapa, who's been helping me get settled in with groceries and other errands since I'm still a weak lil sick baby. Henmama had to go get milk (he had more work) so he couldn't attend to my every need. 

I'll try to do Twitter spaces when my throat's doing better. 
On another note, HOW DO YOU DRINK CARBONATED STUFF? IT'S PAINFUL. 
Is the pain why people like this? I just don't get it. It burns the throat!

If I may get sentimental for a minute here...

I know I've gotten the opportunity to see countless dreams come true in my life and my career. I've done work for so many different IPs I love with all my heart, honors I never thought I'd see through in my life. But this one is a little different, because I don't love any IP more than this one.

Gurren Lagann changed my life about 19 years ago, when I was a very lost and disturbed kid trying to make it through just the simple act of growing up. But it was there for me in my dark moments, and the message this compact and yet perfectly complete series left me with fundamentally altered the way that I look at life, chasing success, and daring to go past your limits and fight to become a "you" that you only could have dreamed of. A "you" that you never thought you could be. It's the story of the impossible dream of a two friends that goes on to become the shared dream of a future for humanity- evolving beyond what is reasonable and beyond what is possible, through what can only be described as boundless hope and belief in the potential of humankind- spiral energy, our passion and the strength of our souls.

And somehow, maybe through the sheer power of the universal will (to be dramatic about it), I was fated to meet Liz and sing this song with her. I'm glad I waited until the time was perfectly right.

To get a chance to OFFICIALLY work on this cover thanks to AniplexUSA and also my fantastic kouhai Liz, this means more to me than I could ever describe with words. So, I hope that by listening to the passion we put into this song, those feelings will come through to you. This meant more to me than you know.

Not only that, but Taku Iwasaki-san's work has been a part of my life since childhood. I'm just so glad.

I hope you dead beats can see the reason why I am the way that I am, the ambitious and ceaseless mori who aims to surpass every single version of herself, even as seconds tick by. I want to become a "me" even greater than the greatest I can be. Always aiming to be more than I am, because that's what this series taught me when I had absolutely no belief in myself.

And look at all the dreams that came true because of it.

...with that said. Let's keep paving a path forward together.
For the view that I want to see- one surrounded in stars, with a dream as big as the galaxy itself!!

-mori

Ello sweethearts! ❤️ 
やっほー、愛しいみんな！❤️

I’ve been pretty much "go go go" since debut, and I’ve finally reached the point where I seriously need a little time to recharge my batteries! So I’m taking my first proper-ish semi-break! HUZZAH! >w</
デビューしてからずーっと「Go! Go! Go!」な毎日を過ごしてきましたが、ついに「これは本気で充電する時間が必要だー！」というところまで来ました！
ということで、初めてのちゃんとした（？）セミ休暇をいただきます！HUZZAH！ >w</

I say “semi” because there’ll still be some rebroadcast streams, and I’ll be working on a few existing project bits n bobs behind the scenes between chillin out but the important thing is I’ll hopefully have some breathing room for a little while, catch up on some life chores, and have proper relax time.
「セミ」なのは、再放送の配信もありますし、のんびりしつつ裏では今あるプロジェクトのお仕事もちょこちょこ進める予定だからです！
でも大事なのは、しばらく少し余裕を作って、溜まっている日常のあれこれを片付けたり、ちゃんとリラックスする時間を取ること！

This’ll be until around the 16th-ish! I’m not gone-gone by any means, but I thought I’d let y’all know this update anyhoo!
だいたい16日頃までの予定です！完全にいなくなるわけでは全然ないけど、一応みんなにお知らせしておこうと思って！

Today’s mission is to finish off the last of my urgent recording, tackle a few life chores and then CHILL THE FRIGGG OUT 😂 I really do need to start listening to my own advice about taking breaks, whoops.
今日のミッションは、急ぎの収録を最後まで終わらせて、日常の用事をいくつか片付けて、そのあとは……思いっきりのんびりするぞーーー！😂
休むことも大事！って自分でいつも言ってるんだから、そろそろ自分のアドバイスもちゃんと聞かないとね！Whoops！

Have a wonderful day my sparks of joy! Please look after yourselves too! 🫵❤️
私の大切な喜びのきらめきのみんな、今日も素敵な一日を過ごしてね！
みんなもちゃんと自分のことを大切にしてね！🫵❤️

Love you all very much! 🫂
みんなのことが大好きです！🫂

Hello grems! Thank you for all your support on GENOUGH! Thank you for watching, leaving comments, engaging with it, wondering about it, being curious on how it all fits in, and if it doesn’t particularly resonate with you, that’s OK too! 

The human experience is so varied that every single person has a unique take, a unique stance, a unique worldview on how they perceive certain themes. But knowing it exists, acknowledging the facets of the varied human experience and thinking about an experience outside of your scope is what connects us as people… I think! 

I’m writing this today because I don’t know when I’ll be able to have a solo stream to talk about this, and also I thought it’d be nice to have a little blog post wrap-up while it’s still fresh on people’s minds. I’ll still talk about it on stream at some point! But I’m not sure in what capacity it’ll be spoken of. I don’t write stuff like this very often too and I’m rusty with my words, so please bear with me!! These are just the stream-of-consciousness ramblings of one Gigi Murin!

“Enough” started with one concept only, the centerpiece of my draft document, the one thing I was firm about since the very beginning: selfcest yuri kiss.

Imagine this, Gigi Murin has a meeting with FLAVOR FOLEY, she presents them her ideas and inspirations, and every 5 seconds she goes, “AND THEY KISS. AND THE TWO GIGI’S KISS! AND THEY BECOME ONE! THERE HAS TO BE A KISS!” and there was.

From ground 0 there was always going to be a selfcest yuri kiss. I wouldn’t be able to give you a reason for this, if anything I think people should want selfcest yuri kisses more often. 

Gigi Murin then makes her rounds to her trusted round table of advisors (her beautiful artists with beautiful minds) she shows them her document of themes she wants to explore, the story she wants to tell, and every 5 seconds “DON’T FORGET ABOUT THE GIGI KISS! THEY KISS AT THE EMOTIONAL CLIMAX OF THE SONG!” And they did. 

I’m very touched and grateful to have been able to work with so many talented people with their own views on being “Enough”, to have colored it with their own feelings and imbue it with the essence of their own experiences. I knew I could trust everyone with the story I wanted to tell and I hope you’re able to see the care in each and every second of the MV! 

And here is where Gigi Murin is being Realistic and this is not ‘Putting Herself Down’ hours, OK? 

I’m not very musically inclined and I know that I don’t excel in these fields. You hand me a mix and I don’t know what I’m listening for. I listen to my singing and think anywhere from ‘ok’ to ‘hey that was pretty decent.’ And oftentimes I find myself having to work around these weaknesses.

But I think about music and MVs that meant something to me. Like everything, I think about music as an art form. I think about the stories that are told in music videos. Hidden meanings in flowery language. Themes hidden in abstract art. And I think about how I want to spend my time creating things that means something to me. 

“Enough” is a song about imposter syndrome (who would have guessed), it’s about identity, it’s about self-acceptance and self-love, it’s about being enough for yourself. All very straight-forward themes but I wanted it unified under selfcest yuri kiss. Don’t forget! It’s my driving force. The light in the cave.

When creating and drafting the concept, I had actually called them “Evil GG” and “GG” in my head. Guess who the evil one was? You get two guesses. 

If you guessed Light GG is the Evil GG then you were right! If you didn’t, then good thing you get two guesses. 
Evil GG and GG later become and will be henceforth known as “JJ” and “GG” further down the pipeline for simplicity sake (thank you art team!)

Narratively, we put so much stock in ‘light = good, dark = bad’ that I wanted to flip it around. This is also just a very gross oversimplification of what was going on but it was the basis of it until the MV eventually evolved into what it currently is. 

But when it comes to yourself, there is nothing inherently good, bad, or evil (as much as we want to define things by set binaries) things are always much more nuanced than that (and we should always be kinder to ourselves).

Both JJ and GG were harmful to each other. Both of them were hurting each other. If you look at the lyrics, most of JJ’s parts are said to be snide and mocking, to push GG further down, and I think this is an important thing that’s easily overlooked! That one of them was more ‘good’ than the other when they’re both flawed ideologies, two sides of the same coin (so to say). 

Both sides harmful to one another, one in its vanity, the other in its self-worth, and it’s not until they accept both halves of themselves, can they become ‘whole’. That both imperfect fragments of you, are you! And that you’re already ‘enough’.

There’s a lot of other thoughts here, but I’ll leave the rest to viewer interpretation (for now, mostly). But I’ve already written so much… and I haven’t even had my recap stream yet! So let this be a little taste.

If you made it this far, thank you for reading! Thank you for always supporting me! I hope I’m always able to create! There’s 5 billion+++ messages in the world, and I hope one of those messages reach you!

Day 3

The island has been peaceful... until today that is.
I helped a new resident named White Falcon today, and somehow he fell in love with me upon first sight! Does he not know I'm already sweethearts with White?

More drama struck after  - White and I had our first fight! He saw me talking with another resident, so he kept interrupting our conversation over and over by walking between us! At first I thought it was a coincidence, but then he did it again. And again. And again! Why was he so jealous!?

The conversation quickly escalated into a brawl where we started throwing items at each other until our mutual friend of Evil Residents, Cop Man, intervened, calming White enough to persuade him into apologizing.

But... I didn't forgive him!

While all this commotion was unfolding in one corner of the island, on the other side, Cop Man and Blue Lion Prince decided to move in together!

. *₊ ° . ☆しおりのトモダチアドベンチャー ☆. °₊*. 

3日目

この島は平和だった……今日まではね。
今日、ホワイト・ファルコンという新しい住人の手助けをしたんだけど、なぜか彼は一目惚れしちゃったみたい！私がもうホワイトと恋人同士だってこと、知らないの？

さらにその後、新たなドラマが巻き起こった――ホワイトと私は初めての喧嘩をしてしまった！彼が、私が別の男性住人と話しているところを目撃し、会話中何度も私たちの間に割り込んできたの！最初は偶然かと思ったけど、またやってのけた。そしてまた。そしてまた！もしかして嫉妬してたの…？

その会話はあっという間に大乱闘へと発展し、お互いに物を投げ合い始めた。そこへ、悪党住人たちの共通の友人であるコップマンが介入し、ホワイトを落ち着かせて謝罪させることに成功した。

しかし……私は彼を許さなかった！

島のその一角で騒動が繰り広げられている間、島の反対側では、コップマンとブルー・ライオン・プリンスが同棲を始めることになった！

Day 2

A third resident moved in today! 
He reminds me of a certain boarish prince, and he keeps rambling about Three Hopes? I'm not too sure, but he's surprisingly serious for a mii! 

Following him was another figure - a former cop apparently! 
During a night time stroll, I saw him pass by and was immediately stumped. 
I must've either been developing a small crush or suffering from heart burn, but I stomped down that feeling and it went away!

On another side of the island, White has this CRAZY idea that I have a crush on him.
I think he's full of himself! It's not like we were alone together on an island for ~36 hours before I decided to allow other miis to EXIST!

By the end of the second day, he asked me a silly question and I decided to say yes.

Two more residents moved soon after!
The first is some amnesiac prince who keeps dreaming of 'White Falcons'.
The second is someone who was saved from a cryopod and decided to live here for recovery. He doesn't talk much about his past, but he hates someone named 'Jimmy'.


. *₊ ° . ☆しおりのトモダチアドベンチャー ☆. °₊*. 

2日目

今日、3人目の住人が引っ越してきた！
彼はとある「イノシシ王子」を彷彿とさせるし、「スリー・ホープス」について延々と語っている？ よく分からないけど、Miiにしては驚くほど真面目だ！

彼の後に、もう一人現れた――どうやら元警察官らしい！
夜の散歩中、彼が通り過ぎるのを見て、私は一瞬、戸惑ってしまった。
ちょっと恋心を抱きかけていたのか、それとも胸焼けだったのか、でもその気持ちを踏み潰したら、すぐに消えちゃった！

島の反対側では、ホワイトが「僕が彼に恋してる」なんてとんでもない思い込みをしてる。
彼は自分勝手すぎる！他のMiiの存在を認める前に、36時間ほど島で二人きりだったからって、そんなことないでしょ！

2日目の終わり頃、彼が馬鹿げた質問をしてきたので、私は「はい」と答えることにした。

その後すぐに、さらに2人の住人が引っ越してきた！
1人目は、記憶喪失の王子で、「ホワイト・ファルコンズ」の夢ばかり見ている。
2人目は、クライオポッドから救出され、回復のためにここに住むことにした人。彼は自分の過去についてあまり話さないけど、「ジミー」という人物を嫌っている。

E・M・フォースター著「機械が止まるとき」を読みます。

What did you guys think?
I was so thrilled to see it charting in various places too, and physical editions finding your hands…seeing stores with low stock on shelves made me happy as well. Are there people in the real world out there listening to my words…?

Since I write my own lyrics, my releases are predisposed to feeling pretty vulnerable. But, over the years, it’s become less frightening. I’m still nowhere near the lyricist or musician I want to be, but each time I release a project, I get closer and closer. 

This work was a much darker, more emotional piece than my previous endeavors, and it’s more likely than not to lighten up in the upcoming releases. Thank you for listening to my words, though.

The one thing I hold on to as a musician is that these words you’re listening to are mine. It’s also the scariest part of being the artist I am. But I see some of you talking about things you relate to, lyrics you’re curious about, mysteries you’re trying to solve within them too. That means more to me than you could ever know. I hope you’ll keep talking about it! I’ll be watching, as always. :}

Thank you again, dead beats. 

I can’t thank you enough for everything.

Perhaps I am still a disaster, but I’m one that will try to make you smile tomorrow.

-Mori

...I WAS NOMINATED FOR BEST VTUBER OF 2025?!

I woke up early today, so before the 12 hour boat stream with holoEN I thought I'd post this.

So, I was nominated for Best VTuber at this year's Streamer Awards.
I'll be honest, Twitch just really isn't the general ecosystem for my content so I was completely blindsided! Turns out you can also be a YouTube streamer to be nominated. In true paternal fashion, I guess I'm a little out of the loop...

I know that award shows are a bit of a spicy topic in creator spaces, but I wanted to say- the only reason I was nominated for this is because real Dead Beats went out of their way to say "I think Mori Calliope deserves an award for Best VTuber." To not acknowledge that, to not share how happy that makes me feel; that doesn't seem right to me. So thank you, from the bottom of my heart. I'll get my talking out of the way now, because I'm not sure if I can really take home this award for you guys and myself. There are some insanely funny and talented folks up there with me. But I need you to know how much it means to me that you even cared enough to put me forward.

If you'd like, you can cast your vote here.
https://thestreamerawards.com/vote



This news also made me realize what a year we have all had together!
I did things I never thought I'd do. So I'd like to take a moment to highlight some of the insane things that happened this year...

Performed a sold-out solo show in America at the iconic Hollywood Palladium! Sang in front of the Emperor of Japan! Made an anime opening and insert song for my favorite manga of all time turned into an anime! Made the theme song for a renowned Japanese comedy show with a legendary Japanese idol! Raised $200,000 together with Biboo for wildlife conservation in a 24 hour stream!

Played one of the greatest game series of all time (yes I am still DMC brainrotted)!!

I bet you guys will come up with even more insane things we did this year.

5 years ago, when the music scene I was involved in fell apart during the pandemic, I was at the end of my rope and absolutely sure I'd go back to America to try to make a modest living with a job and medium I no longer had any passion for. To see that things managed to shake out this way...I don't know if anyone's pulling the strings of fate, but if they are, I'm so grateful. 

And even more-so to you guys. I know I'm goofy and not the most conventional idol or star, but you chose to push me forward. And I wanna spend the rest of my time on the internet making you guys smile, and having lots of fun together. So let's do it!

I'll try to remind myself of all we've accomplished every once in a while!! I tend to let it slip away from me too much!!


tl;dr thank you so much everyone, I'm beyond grateful this is my job, I'll keep working hard to make it up to you. IKZ!!!

-Mori

!! THANKS FOR 300...wait...400k !!

I started drawing this once the count hit 300k views but by the time I finished...we had surpassed 400k?! Thanks so much, everyone!

The team worked so hard on this MV. It was a bit of a risky move as this kind of cartoony 3D animation is not a popular choice for music videos amongst Holo, but I wanted to try something new here and Kameyama-san was the perfect choice.

I reached out to Kameyama-san when I was seriously on my last leg in regards to MVs. The original studio I planned to ask (who I'd contacted a couple times in the past) couldn't work on the MV, even though I'd already begun imagining their work for it. I was seriously down about it and just didn't know what to do or where to turn to make something fitting for this work. Then, Kameyama-san's art and Milky Subway (not yet released but Milky Highway pilot was out) found it's way to my timeline. I can never be more grateful for having encountered his work. It was pure luck, but I'm so glad I wound up choosing what was effectively the best production for this song's MV after all. I would not go back and do it differently!

And, Kanaban Graphics being entrusted with the CG was the perfect choice.
I really hope people will continue to enjoy a snapshot of this little world we created together. My original idea was a bit closer to Redline, but we ended up moving towards Mad Max and MCR's "Danger Days: The True Lives of the Fabulous Killjoys" universe I worshipped in my high school years...and I wouldn't have it any other way.

I want a figure of this insane woman here, so I hope you guys will continue just enjoying the MV and we can watch it fly together. Watch it as much as it makes you happy. Share it with people you think will like it. Who knows what may happen in the future if things keep going well...? We'll see!

-Mori

HELLO MY GREMLINGS!!!
I’ve spent a lot of time reading through your kind messages and heartfelt letters on both YouTube and Twitter and it’s been very healing!!

Since its realllyyy present on my mind right now and we’re about to have a hard reset with some streams in between, I just wanted to get some words out while it was still fresh 🙂‍↕️

While I intend to talk more about the creative processes that went into the making and conception of the song on stream, I’m not really good at talking about emotions and feelings… So I don’t know how much of that I’ll cover 🥸

I’ve been thinking about this for a long time, basically since debut, that I wanted to put something out that means a lot to me. 

Something that’s intrinsically a part of me, has shaped me, and at its core, is a part of who I am.

I think I wouldn’t be here today if not for gigipapa. He was my biggest supporter of all time!! He indulged in my love for anime, brought me and my friends to anime conventions, bought me strange wigs just because I wanted them, taught me about art, music, old television shows, the stars, and he never once questioned or belittled anything I wanted to do or any of the dreams that I had (even tho I was a rly cringe kid…. But u know.. I was a kid)

I don’t talk about gigipapa on stream not for any strong reason, but mostly because I know it turns into a heavy topic and I typically don’t have the mental capacity to deal with that sort of conversation. It’s become a defense mechanism of sorts, you avoid talking about something long enough, you don’t have to deal with the awkwardness of having to have that conversation with someone on the street that you hardly know. It just gets easier to avoid it than it is to confront it.

So I hope you understand if I’m reticent to share or talk about these feelings as a part of my boundaries! That’s not to say I think you shouldn’t talk about it at ALL, but have some kindness if I noticeably avoid a question or a message just because I’m not in the headspace to do so.

But I think art is beautiful!! Art resonates with people in so many ways and affects them differently and speaks to them at different points in life. Art gives you a way to express yourself, all those feelings inside of you, concentrated and formed like a little ball into one thing. And once it’s done you can just shoot it out into the universe and close your eyes and pretend you didn’t do that!! 

And I’ve always wanted to create something, a celebration of life, something that just screams “I’ll keep going!!!!!” 

I don’t think loss or grief ever goes away, you carry a part of that with you every day. I once heard it described as, at first, it starts off really big, and it can’t stop bumping into the walls and causing you to get upset. But over time it gets smaller and smaller, and it stops bumping into the walls as much, but every once in a while it’ll hit the wall and remind you it’s there.

Thinking about it in this way had helped me a lot in the beginning, and I do believe that you become stronger. You carry those good times with you and it gives you hope for a better future, sometimes things are bleak and you don’t know if there’s any way of digging yourself out of that hole and you’ve resigned to sitting at the bottom of it. Even though it’s hard, I hope you’re able to find a reason to stand up, and know that I’ll be cheering you on!!!

Thank you for entrusting me with your words and stories, I’m happy you’re all here in the shoebox with me!!

Dear otomos!!!
All for One is done!!! AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAa we did it!!!
Both days with both concerts were so much fun.. I'm so so so grateful for all of you who cheered for me!
Be it in person, on youtube, twitter, at home, loudly, silently or at the venue!!!!
Seeing your words and reactions and just the general positivity that this event had for us and for you (!?) has made it all worth it!

I personally haven't really realised the scale of certain things we do yet and even while being at the venue and hearing all of you cheer and seeing the crowd.. it still hasn't really hit me. I've always been a bit weird and head in the clouds with these things where I just do something and I'm like "hell yeah" but I don't think about it much more. 
But once I woke up this morning, I rewatched some of the concert stream itself and I think it's slowly sinking in. 
Just the sheer amount of effort and manpower that went into this concert, the fact that we performed at Radio City Hall and the fact that some of you came to the concert from all over the world to listen to me.. so many people.. so many lightsticks!
While walking around the city I even saw some otomos with happis on and it was so crazy!!
It's very surreal.. I think I'll have to ponder it a bit more and then maybe once it hits me, I'll have more profound words to share with you.. 
But right now I'm just happy! No thoughts, head empty, just happy!
I'm glad we all did a great job, super proud to have been allowed to perform alongside all these incredibly hardworking girls and grateful to you for taking the time out of your day to listen to us and cheer us on. 

I really love music and moving forward I just want to make more of it and perform for you again! Please keep cheering for me and honestly, truly, thank you so much!
Even if my head is empty and I'm at a loss for words (as always with these things..) I do know that I feel incredibly thankful to you otomos! If it weren't for you, I would never be able to do these things, stand on this stage and I wouldn't be nearly as happy as I am right now. So thank you!
Thank you for being there for me and for always supporting me in small and big projects! Thank you for laughing alongside me and being so kind! Thank you!!


Let's keep having fun together and wind up high!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Your
Cecilia~

I’m just a little creature that plays video games in my cave to a maximum of 5 people (exaggeration) at all times, and you’re telling me that I’ll be performing in front of THOUSANDS??? That’s not real at all!!! 

But sitting here after the high of the concert in my hotel room, scrolling social media, and reminiscing over this weekend, it all hit me!!! 

I performed in front of thousands of people!
There were grems wandering around the streets of New York, flying in from around the globe, to see me!
That you came to my panel at ANYC! To support me!!! 
That so many grems watched it live on the streaming site!! And that you were proud of me!! 

It’s been one whole year (and some extra days) since I’ve become a part of Hololive, and I hope I can be a part of your life for even more.

Thank you everyone for supporting me!! I will keep doing my best! There’s still many, many things I want to say, but it’s hard to convey everything in text.

In all my life, I never thought I’d be able to see this view. I always thought that I’d only ever be in the crowd.

Thank you!!!

RONDO-Revolution, my first duet with Liz, dropping TOMORROW! On May 3rd, 8am CST / 9am EST / 10pm JST !!!

This has been in the works for months now, so I'm absolutely DELIGHTED to finally be sharing it with all of you! Honestly, it feels like forever since I released a proper cover so I hope you guys are excited for it! I'll look forward to seeing you all at the video premiere, and I can't wait to see what you all think about it <3

I watched Utena for the first time about a year ago and absolutely fell in love with it - I love shows with a lot of symbolism, and the 90's aesthetic is SO wonderful! Since the anime features 2 female leads, I knew that if I covered this song, it had to be a duet. So of course, who better to sing it with than Elizabeth Rose Bloodframe - playing the part of Anthy Himemiya, the Rose Bride! Selfishly, I wanted to be the more princely Utena, so I hope you guys will enjoy seeing a different side of me~

Here's an interesting factoid about the song: it's often misread as "Rinbu" Revolution, due to the kanji. Though this is technically the "correct" reading of the kanji, the song has only ever verbally been referred to as "Rondo" revolution! The kanji was used for the meaning it holds, as was the choice to read it as rondo, giving it a deeper meaning that I can probably explain better on stream, so I'll do it next time I'm live and tell you all about it...!

Thank you guys so much for waiting patiently for me, I know I've been a bit scarce due to how busy I've been, but I hope this cover will make up for it a little bit! I have a few more fun things dropping throughout this month, so please keep both your eyes and ears peeled~

Actually, there are English subtitles for this one!
I wanted to do a song that's 100% in Japanese, with the idea that for my next big release, I'd write an |English version for it. But doing a song fully written by one of my idols in jrap was something I couldn't miss out on!
The song itself carries a lot of my own feelings. I expressed wanting to sing a song about getting caught up in the madness of something, the excitement of a party or the tension of having a persona you show to the world, and feeling like there's an old "you" that you can't truly go back to, but you want to search for and find.

It's about evolution in the midst of madness, basically!
I though it'd be fitting to release it with such a big event like my new 3D model, as well as the concert that celebrates my roots.

J-Rap is something that I love, but won't really be doing much more of in the future. That's why I wanted to create something one last time that encapsulates 100% what those vibes I fell in love with are.

I hope you'll enjoy it! It's also being featured on the cover of the "JAPANIQUE" playlist on YouTube music, so listen to it lots there, okay? ^^

ENReco Diary Entry #1
Doko the hell am I?

At least, that’s the first thing I thought to say and I’m not really sure why!
My body (?) felt so heavy, my head was throbbing…then I woke up in this weird blue fog where I met a bunch of boneheads. Must have been all of you! Cheeky skeletons…apparently I called you “Calliopeople” in my past life? So I guess I’ll stick to that name!

Since you guys can’t speak with words that reach my ears physically, I feel pretty comfortable around you all! But when it comes to people…

Case in point, I found myself in this weird asylum-like white box and thought I’d gone mental but all I ended up doing was spilling my spaghetti and solving nothing. I hid pretty quickly from everyone in a corner…but then, some of the other introverts said hi. Maybe there are more like me…?

The orange one!! Kiara HoloEN…I guess we were friends in another life. I want to stick with her, but for the time being, it seems I’ve been relegated to this strange green guild in a distant land called Libestal. There’s some kind of shadowy threat (wow, cool!) and I’m thinking, why am I not helping the shadowy guys? Aren’t they like, my relatives? But the king gave me this sick cape and I’m like okay, for the swag? I’ll help! Plus, I got my scythe back…yeah, there’s a big twist to this story actually.

After braving the Underworld with my two (kinda ecchi?) friends, we solved a really big mystery…and it involved my memories.
…But seriously, those two are unhinged. IRySuperGlue is really unashamed with her words, but part of me feels that she knows not what she do be saying?! Ouro Kronii is the one who is apparently planning a marriage to the king so that she can inherit the land…incoming regicide, huh….oh but don’t tell the king! That’s a secret between besties, you see!

Those two are in the guild known as Cerulean Cup. Me? I’m in “Jade Sword.” We’re known for our bravery apparently, and we do what’s right! Well, when it comes to killing, that’s just what I do, ya know? So yeah, guess I’m brave when it comes to that n’ all. People? Now that’s a little different…I seriously can’t talk to anyone!

Maybe I need to challenge myself to be more extroverted…? Make more memories with new people?

Because my past ones I mentioned? They’re pretty bleak. Look, I betrayed my ENTIRE race of reapers…all to follow some ridiculous dream. Chasing happiness through music, seeking to help humans instead of harm them…it’s all too good to be true. I’ve always wanted to help people, but witnessing that memory of mine- did I have to forgoe all that I learned for the sake or just some “dream?” The me back then seemed so resolute, but why?

Is there any way I can connect the pieces of my consciousness and understand why I even made that decision and why I didn’t regret it? So basically, I’ve decided to try and live out that mission- help humans if I can. See why that old me ever thought like that. Maybe then something will start to make sense here…

In any case, what’s even worse is that EVERY HERO summoned to Libestal like me ended up SEEING that embarrassing memory! Now they know I’m a wishy-washy flip flopping traitor! Who’s to say I won’t betray THEM, huh?

My head hurts…I barely did anything today compared to the others, so tomorrow, it’s time for progress on all fronts!

I WILL become someone that people can rely on. But the question is how. And when?
Sleep…time for sleep in the arena…I wonder if I’ll be awoken by someone’s battle?

I kind of hope so! But hopefully my services as reaper aren’t needed for a while.

-Calliope of Jade Sword

I’ve been pushing hard with music for a long time, and to see that no matter how many doubts about myself I still have, things still seem to be on the up and up in the music department and I want to push it further still, just a little!

I hope you guys will love it!
Until then…time for grass.

▼△▼!! 40 MILLION VIEWS !!▼△▼

I thought since this is a big milestone, I'd write up some of my thoughts.

This was my debut song, one of the first I'd ever written outside of my usual environment, almost about 4 years ago. A lot has changed since then- back then I had my aspirations and things I wanted to do, and I wanted to show the world that I was serious about making music, but it was still a lot more laid-back and playful of a time...until it wasn't and we debuted and things became crazier than we imagined. 

The future was really unclear for me back then, and I'd gotten my feet wet but hadn't taken the dive. The hype around Myth's debut made it hard to focus on figuring out what I wanted to say with my work, so I floated around a bit formlessly for a while.

I think every artist, to an extent, harbors a bit of disdain for their early work, their most popular work, or in my case- both. There are many times where I feel conflicted, thinking "with all the work I'm doing now that is leaps and bounds above this one, why is this the one that so many people wanted to hear? Why is this the one that brought so many people in?" And by now I've seen a range of answers, some heartwarming, some hard to hear.

But there is no changing how instrumental this song was to my beginnings, and even to the person I've become. It was a benchmark- a place for me to start I guess. And honestly, I can't say I'd have the opportunities that I've had without this very song.

From an extremely confused but motivated pink weirdo trying to impress everyone on stream and failing, with just one song she became something a little more interesting than that. 

Regardless, I'm grateful. Thank you so much for bringing me here, and for listening to this song. Even if this is my limit, I have no regrets because when all is said and done, I owe a lot to this song and I owe a lot to you!

Thanks for reading this far!

If you're still here, consider grabbing my brand new album coming out this summer! It's my proudest work yet.
The journey never ends!!

I really hope it never ends!

My new album is coming, everyone!
The "go-getter" album of all my releases, so to speak...listening back to just the tracks we've already recorded, and the demos I've received, I'm already feeling this as my favorite release so far.
Studio sessions went from 3 hours to 7 hours, and I'm really thinking critically about my work these days, and what you guys hear. But worry not, I'm still having a good time!

Truth is, it was rough before working on this album. I really felt like music was becoming something hard for me to listen to and engage with, and there are various reasons but slowly and surely I began listening to music again and loving it, just as I used to. I think a lot of that shows up in this release.

I don't want to give away too much about the themes this album encompasses, but I'll give you a small idea...the concept of "Pantomime" and putting on a show of how you are feeling, thinking, and showing yourself to the world around you. Every day, we pantomime our ways through life and do what we must for survival in various parts of our lives. Being dragged into different "faces" and masks that we wear, playing multiple roles in the stage show that is our lives.

But beneath the surface, what's actually going on?

Hey, skeletons! It’s Your Boy. Just saying howdy!

Things have been difficult but I’m hanging in there! I’ve been spending my days endlessly watching movies, but after today’s appointment it looks like I’ll have more mobility options and will be focus on my rehabilitation for my knee.

I don’t like to worry any of you, but the surgery had complications and ended up being twice as long as the doctor anticipated. I was in much worse shape than they had imagined, and the way I was exercising really did a number on not just my knee, but many things connected to it. It has been a really taxing process and I’m still in a lot of pain even right now. But you know me, I’m not giving up on healing! (Not like I have a choice, but a couple nights after the surgery I really could only think “I’m not going to make it!!”)

It’s just tough because, I like to identify what I can do to help and better myself and do it. But in this case, the only way to get better is by doing nothing at all- better yet, “relaxing” which is something I’m notoriously bad at…all dead people (and dead beats) know this…

It is definitely a good thing I’m taking a long rest. The other day I was just thinking about what to grab for lunch and started crying and hyperventilating on the spot…imagine? How is the Grim Reaper herself crying and dry heaving over which sandwich to get, and whether I should skip out on chips?! I think feeling immobile, useless and otherwise “pathetic” has something to do with it. 8'{
They told me I’d be emotional after surgery, but this is on another level…so, I don’t think I’m stable to stream, and won’t be for longer than I initially thought. I have a ballpark estimate of when I’ll be back, and it’s the end of May. We’ll still do members only streams, but get ready for them to be crammed in the last 3 days or so!

Anyway, that’s my report. 
Do you Dead Beats have any shows you enjoyed marathoning, or movie recommendations? Specifically, I really like thrillers with psychological twists…!
How about games on Steam that pair well with the Steam Deck? I think I’m finally feeling better enough to enjoy video games again, so if you have any Steam Deck recommended games let me know!

Thanks for your patience, everyone!

I’ll keep myself on the healing track so we can return to conquest over humanity immediately upon my return. B}

-Mori

Hey Dead Beats! The Zutomayo concert was AMAZING…I got to perform a couple songs with ACAね (including Kira Killer) and generally hype up the crowd. Then I got to eat the fried rice they made on stage!! There was natto on it…which made it even more delicious! B}

Truth is, the plan was to go back to America after Australia and get ready for surgery. But then I got invited to perform, and there’s no way I was saying no to that! So I flew back to Japan to share the stage with someone I look up to so much.
I felt really privileged to be invited. We rehearsed morning to night, for 3 whole days, which meant no time for streams. I thought for sure we’d get to finish Red Dead 2 before I left, but I don’t want to rush through the ending of one of my favorite games I’ve ever played on stream. 態度, changing your perspective and once again finding passion for the thing you love."

I love writing my own lyrics, but these days I can't help but feel a little afraid sharing myself and my mind with a world full of so many people, and lots of different eyes and ears on what I do.

It's like I've decided to turn the tide by changing my perspective, in the end!

No more living "sick and tired." No apologies required!

10. glass slipper

SIN CLASSIFICATION: ENVY

I didn't want to just write another "jealousy bad" song.
So I thought I'd take a different stance, and I'd try to take a look at my past self, who I still hold envy for.

Clueless, nonchalant but also happy and mentally and physically healthy. I'm getting better, but I'm not quite where I used to be back in the day. I didn't know what I had back then, in some regards. Now let's not pretend that my present is anything to scoff at, hold up....maybe an additional sin should have been ungratefulness? There are still some days that feel sad. Maybe that's just human nature, and that's okay.

But, to feel envious of a me that took a different path, to a me that existed long ago- all these other "myselfs" walking like ghosts around me; it's not good. And that's why it's a sin to me. Each day I'm working harder and harder to not only be the best Mori I can be, but also be at peace with myself and find happiness in whatever form it might take. Mama Mori always told me that I focus a lot on making others happy, I don't have any time to search for my own happiness. But I think coming here and finding my way as The Grim Reaper changed my life for the better, and even though I may wonder "what could have been," it doesn't matter.

I think I can truly say I'm on the path to finding my own happiness!

"Still, time let's me escape. Before the future takes shape, I'll rip the sutures of undesirable fate."
"Somewhere, beyond the darkened ocean, stars I'll reach soon dance along the waves."


There's still so much treasure left for us to find!!

Yours,
Mori

09. Death Sentence

SIN CLASSIFICATION: Guilt

So sometimes, when you get all sinful and shit, you may start to feel guilty.
That's right. We've done all these sins, we feel bad about 'em...now you're gonna call us even MORE sinful for being guilty about it, Mori?? wtf

Well, not really. These sins are basically things I associate with myself, and guilt is something I occasionally feel to detrimental levels.

Guilt for not hitting expectations, guilt for not being what a company, a label, a group of people wanted me to be. Guilt for not hitting charts, guilt for not having as big of a reach as I promised. It still gets to me, as much as I try to push through it. Sometimes it muddles my mind and keeps me from moving forward, it's really an annoying blockade in my path but it's real.

What I really love about this song though- it was a cool opportunity to record entirely in auto-tune and be able to hear my voice that way while recording in studio. I wanted a more atmospheric, chill and vocal choppy track since I've heard such examples on other albums by favorites of mine. Why not mix it up as we approach the end of the album by adding something that's more about the overall feeling, vibe and lyrics, the SOUND- rather than the "technical rap or singing" I usually try focusing on.

I hope you'll enjoy it, as it means a lot to me.

Yours,
Mori

Before my time studying to becoming a detective, it's like I was bumbling through a forest. 
It was more quiet and damp, but still beautiful. 
Like sunlight, spots shining through leaves and shimmering on the ground.

Short Story: Streams for the next little while may or may not happen depending on if I can get new internet connection in time!

Long Story: Recently I have been noticing a pretty steep drop to my upload speeds while my download speeds were the same. It seemed relatively okay for the most part so I was still able to stream with a few hiccups.

I've contacted my ISP regarding this problem before and the answer was always the same "nothing is wrong, try turning it off and on again or connecting with a wire"
This time though, I got a solid answer saying that I was using too much upload bandwidth and that I need to upgrade to a different plan for a better speed because of the "sheer amount of upload bandwidth" I was using : D
So...I'll look into actually upgrading with this ISP or actually finding a different ISP for the next couple of days! I'll weigh the options properly and decide which would be the best option.

I also did think of switching ISP/plans before (I already upgraded my plans at least twice after my debut _(:3/ L)_), but as I have been planning to get a separate place to stream from I haven't moved forward with it since I didn't want to commit to a long term contract and have to pay double bills when time came ; w;;

I want to be able to stream to you guys at the highest and most stable conditions as possible, and I feel like I let you down with my recent breathing tube and internet problems..I'm really sorry...! I am actively looking to fix both problems so I really appreciate your patience...!

There are plans for the streams the next couple of days, but they might have to be rescheduled to a different date depending on when I can get my internet fixed.

I am deeply sorry again for the trouble and thank you very much for your understanding...!
